result:
The smallest n greater than 2013 with f(n) odd is 2047. This rests on a pattern I checked only up to n = 13, not on a proof.

Since the order of the summands matters, conditioning on the first term gives f(n) = Σ over k with 2^k ≤ n of f(n − 2^k), with f(0) = 1.

Computing the first values gives f(1)=1, f(2)=2, f(3)=3, f(4)=6, f(5)=10, f(6)=18, f(7)=31, f(8)=56, f(9)=98, f(10)=174, f(11)=306, f(12)=542, f(13)=?.

For f(13), the recurrence gives f(12)+f(11)+f(9)+f(5) = 542+306+98+10 = 956, which is even.

Among n = 1 through 13, f(n) is odd only for n = 1, 3, 7, which are the numbers of the form 2^k − 1. I did not compute n = 14 or 15, so f(15) being odd is part of the pattern rather than a checked value. I also did not prove the pattern holds for larger n.

Assuming it does, the smallest such n above 2013 is 2^11 − 1 = 2047, since 2^10 − 1 = 1023 is too small.

ANSWER: 2047
